consequence.statement: A buckets.source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta2 Bucket object that omits status.artifact.digest is rejected by schema validation after the upgrade, per the computed diff of the install bundles.

original.statement: In the source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta2 schema of buckets.source.toolkit.fluxcd.io, the Bucket field status.artifact.digest is newly required, and Bucket objects that omit it are rejected.

decision.reason: Validators comparing the v2.6.4 [ev-782bc47d120d] and v2.7.0 [ev-c2c6c790d6b2] install bundles confirm that status.artifact.digest becomes required in the Bucket source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta2 schema. The computed change says objects that omit it are rejected, so resource-rejected is the kind the evidence supports. The excerpts themselves say nothing about who writes this status field or whether objects already stored are affected before they are next written. That is why confidence is low, and the severity is not settled by the evidence.
